name: Griffith Brighter Futures Scholarship
summary: Up to $20,000 over a degree for Griffith undergraduates facing educational disadvantage, or $40,000 for eligible permanent residents.
key: $625 per 10 credit points: $5,000 for a one-year award, or up to $20,000 over a four-year degree. Permanent residents get double.
numbers: A one-off $500 early payment on enrolment
who: Australian citizens, permanent residents, permanent humanitarian visa holders and New Zealand citizens.

Griffith undergraduates, starting or continuing, assessed as educationally disadvantaged: financial hardship, home responsibilities, English language difficulty, illness or disability, disrupted schooling, or remoteness.
Commencing students need an ATAR above 85 or equivalent, which Griffith may adjust for disadvantage. Continuing students need a GPA of 4.5 or more.
how: Check the before-you-apply list, then apply in Griffith's online scholarship system.
Include your income and spending, any other scholarships and your circumstances.
catches: You can't hold any other scholarship funding.
You can't already have an Australian bachelor degree, unless it's a prerequisite for your program.
You must keep a GPA of 4.5 or more, checked each trimester at census.
Payments while studying part-time may be taxable.
Trimester 1, 2027 rounds close 21 December 2026, 27 January 2027 and 15 March 2027.
